svg.aria-label: Relay, an open-source side project: the agent runs on your machine through the relayrun CLI, the server orders every event and holds the driver lock, and every viewer sees the same sequence while control passes mid-task.

svg.text: Live shared sessions for AI coding agents. One person drives, control passes mid-task.
